verdict.rationale: stagewise's docs say the desktop IDE runs multiple agent instances in parallel, each with its own chat session and model. It also connects several project folders at once and stays awake while agents work, which covers the core of running many agent sessions in one workspace. The docs never describe how a lead manages those sessions, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: a documented session overview or dashboard for monitoring status and progress across parallel agents, documented controls for switching, pausing, or stopping individual sessions, per-session review management, and independent or hands-on confirmation that parallel sessions work as claimed.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: stagewise supports multiple agent instances running in parallel. Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Connect several project folders at once so agents can work across your full stack
keep the app awake while agents work
